description: Learner-matched event context: LightGBM on the champion's features + the event aux family (se-aux-event-v1, as in se8_lr_event). Compare with se1_lgbm_mm (same learner and params) to read the family effect without the learner effect; added 2026-10-21 because the development walk-forward shows the LightGBM learner alone beats the logistic champion, so an event effect measured on the logistic learner would not transfer to a LightGBM champion. Trains only when every labelled capture of the target's window has the event table; never predicts without it.
